gcp.kms.operation.hsm_large.note: HSM RSA 3072/4096 and elliptic curve operations, which share this price; random bytes too. Admin operations are free. One SKU for every location; sync reads it in us-central1.

filters.description: HSM cryptographic operations with a RSA 3072 bit key

gcp.kms.operation.standard.note: Software symmetric operations; HSM symmetric, RSA 2048, MAC, software asymmetric and external operations have the same price. Admin operations are free. One SKU for every location; sync reads it in us-central1.

filters.description: Cryptographic operations with a software symmetric key

gcp.kms.version.external.note: External (Cloud EKM) key version. Active means enabled, disabled or scheduled for destruction. The catalog prices a version-month, 730 version-hours; one SKU for every location, read in us-central1.

gcp.kms.version.hsm.note: HSM symmetric or RSA 2048 key version. Active means enabled, disabled or scheduled for destruction. The catalog prices a version-month, 730 version-hours; one SKU for every location, read in us-central1.

gcp.kms.version.hsm_large.note: HSM RSA 3072/4096 or elliptic curve key version, at the first-2,000-a-month price (the SKU's first tier; $1 above). Active means enabled, disabled or scheduled for destruction. The catalog prices a version-month, 730 version-hours; one SKU for every location, read in us-central1.

filters.description: Active HSM RSA 3072 bit key versions

gcp.kms.version.software.note: Software key version (symmetric; software asymmetric and MAC keys have the same price). Active means enabled, disabled or scheduled for destruction. The catalog prices a version-month, 730 version-hours; one SKU for every location, read in us-central1.
